notes.title: Citalis v3.4 Update
notes.content:
- Added a new interactive tutorial when starting a new classic mode game
- Restricted value to be entered into lump sum textbox (to prevent crashing)
- Fixed limit on naming business to 16 characters
- Saved fullscreen preferences (now remembers if you were playing fullscreen or windowed mode etc)
- Clicking on a business will default to the details menu to save a bit of clicking
- Added more music!

notes.title: Citalis v3.3 Update
notes.content:
- Changed house labelling 
- Addded a 'low housing' warning
- Added a 'road destroyed' warning 
- Changed some colors that were difficult to read
- Added an easy difficulty setting for classic mode. This reduces how much you need to repay each day (lowers 'to pay' multiplier)

notes.title: Citalis v3.2 Update
notes.content:
- Balancing! Lowered 'to pay' multiplier in classic mode, increased upgrade effects and reduced the crime multiplier.
- Added tutorial link to game menu 
- Game now pauses when naming a new district

- Refined district swapping
